extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/practitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO (Office of Enrollment and Discipline)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural decision concerning a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including submission of an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and Director review of eligibility. The document records the Director's determination to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Mitchell has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is a required/supporting element of a petition for reinstatement; the affidavit is considered by the Director as part of the record when evaluating eligibility for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (submission requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Christopher P. Mitchell received on March 10, 2020.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petitioner must submit a formal Petition for Reinstatement to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the receipt and contents of that petition are prerequisites for administrative consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of review for reinstatement eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director's reinstatement decision is based on a comprehensive review of (1) the petition, (2) any supporting affidavits (e.g., under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58), and (3) all other record information material to eligibility; sufficiency and persuasiveness of these materials determine the outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to grant or deny reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Mitchell to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline) has the authority to grant or deny petitions for reinstatement based on the record; the decision is rendered in an official decision document.
